It saw [[Étoile du Sahel]] win the championship. At the other end of the table, [[Etoile Olympique de la Goulette et Kram]] and [[ES Hammam-Sousse]] were relegated to [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|Ligue Professionnelle 2]]. ==Teams and locations== *[[AS Marsa]] *[[Club Africain]] *[[CA Bizertin]] *[[CS Hammam-Lif]] *[[CS Sfaxien]] *[[EGS Gafsa]] *[[Espérance de Tunis]] *[[ES Zarzis]] *[[ES Hammam-Sousse]] *[[Etoile Olympique de la Goulette et Kram|EO Goulette et Kram]] *[[Étoile du Sahel]] *[[Olympique Béja]] *[[Stade Tunisien]] *[[US Monastir (football)|US Monastir]] {{Location map+ |Tunisia |width=300 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2007–08 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 |places= {{Location map~ |Tunisia |lat=36.8 |long=10.183333 |label=Tunis teams:
